paper.title_en: Confronting $b \to (s, d)μ^+ μ^-$ and $\mathcal{L}_{K^{*}\bar{K}^{*}}$ puzzle in a $U(1)_{B-3L_μ}$ framework with neutrino phenomenology
paper.abstract_en: Current data on several observables in $b \to (s,d)$$μ^+ μ^-$ transitions reveal certain discrepancies with Standard Model (SM) predictions. Considering the possibility that these deviations stem from new physics, we explore a $Z^{\prime}$ framework based on $U(1)_{B-3L_μ}$ model. The parameter space is examined in light of existing constraints from $b \to (s,d)$$μ^+ μ^-$ transitions. Within this framework, we show that the quark couplings accommodating $b \to (s,d)$$μ^+ μ^-$ anomalies, imprint correlated signatures on the non-leptonic puzzles $\mathcal{L}_{K^{*}\bar{K}^{*}}$ in $B_{s(d)} \to K^{*}\bar{K}^{*}$ decays. We find that the scenario with both vector and axial-vector contributions of opposite sign is favored by the data compared to pure vector contribution, offering a correlated probe of the underlying new-physics scenario. We further explore the neutrino phenomenology within the same framework in light of current data.
